static boolean fmInfeasible(List<LinExpr> ineqs) {
  List<LinExpr> list = new ArrayList<>();
  for e: if e.isConstant() { if e.const >0 return true; } else list.add(e);
  if list.isEmpty() return false;
  Set<String> vars = new TreeSet<>();
  for e in list vars.addAll(e.coeffs.keySet());
  for v in vars:
    if list.isEmpty() return false;
    List<LinExpr> next = new ArrayList<>();
    List<LinExpr> pos = new ArrayList<>(), neg = new ArrayList<>();
    for e in list:
      BigInteger c = e.coeff(v);
      if c == null || c.signum()==0) next.add(e);
      else if c.signum()>0) pos.add(e); else neg.add(e);
    if (pos.isEmpty() || neg.isEmpty()) { list = next; continue; }
    for p in pos:
      BigInteger a = p.coeff(v);
      for n in neg:
        BigInteger c = n.coeff(v); // negative
        LinExpr newE = p.scale(c.negate()).add(n.scale(a));
        // newE should not contain v (barring bug)
        if (newE.isConstant()) { if newE.const >0 return true; } else next.add(newE);
    list = next;
    if (list.size() > FM_MAX) return false; // assume feasible
    // optional remove constant <=0? keep
  for e in list: if e.isConstant() && e.const >0 return true;
  return false;
}
```

static boolean fmInfeasible(List<LinExpr> ineqs) {
  List<LinExpr> list = new ArrayList<>();
  for e: if e.isConstant() { if e.const >0 return true; } else list.add(e);
  if list.isEmpty() return false;
  Set<String> vars = new TreeSet<>();
  for e in list vars.addAll(e.coeffs.keySet());
  for v in vars:
    if list.isEmpty() return false;
    List<LinExpr> next = new ArrayList<>();
    List<LinExpr> pos = new ArrayList<>(), neg = new ArrayList<>();
    for e in list:
      BigInteger c = e.coeff(v);
      if c == null || c.signum()==0) next.add(e);
      else if c.signum()>0) pos.add(e); else neg.add(e);
    if (pos.isEmpty() || neg.isEmpty()) { list = next; continue; }
    for p in pos:
      BigInteger a = p.coeff(v);
      for n in neg:
        BigInteger c = n.coeff(v); // negative
        LinExpr newE = p.scale(c.negate()).add(n.scale(a));
        // newE should not contain v (barring bug)
        if (newE.isConstant()) { if newE.const >0 return true; } else next.add(newE);
    list = next;
    if (list.size() > FM_MAX) return false; // assume feasible
    // optional remove constant <=0? keep
  for e in list: if e.isConstant() && e.const >0 return true;
  return false;
}
```
